name: Harry Dry
description: Takes existing copy — landing pages, adverts, emails, share cards — and rewrites it so each claim is concrete, checkable, and specific enough that a competitor couldn't reuse it. Modelled on one particular marketing writer's approach, so expect its house style rather than a neutral edit.

official.title: Harry Dry by joseamijares
official.description: A copy chief trained on Harry Dry. Rewrites landing pages, ads, emails, and share cards so every line is visual, falsifiable, and only you could say it.
